title: H-OPD: Confidence Aware Heterogeneous Multi-Teacher Multimodal On-policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2607.02592v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as an effective post-training paradigm by providing supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, existing OPD methods for multimodal reasoning usually rely on a static teacher routing, assigning each sample to a single teacher based on modality or task type. This ignores that visual grounding and abstract reasoning may dominate different decoding steps, making a single teacher insufficient for the full trajectory. To this end, H-OPD is proposed as a confidence-aware heterogeneous multi-teacher OPD framework for multimodal reasoning. By verifying the complementarity of heterogeneous teachers in the same reasoning process, H-OPD replaces task or sample level teacher routing with token-level teacher arbitration along the shared student trajectory. translated_title: H-OPD：置信度感知的异构多教师多模态在线蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在线蒸馏近期已成为一种有效的后训练范式，它通过在学生模型生成的轨迹上提供监督信号来实现训练。然而，现有的面向多模态推理的在线蒸馏方法通常依赖于静态的教师路由，即根据模态或任务类型将每个样本分配给单一教师。这种方式忽略了视觉定位和抽象推理可能在不同解码步骤中轮流占主导地位，使得单一教师难以胜任完整的轨迹生成。为此，本文提出了 H-OPD，一种面向多模态推理的置信度感知异构多教师在线蒸馏框架。通过验证异构教师在同一推理过程中的互补性，H-OPD 用沿共享学生轨迹进行的 token 级教师仲裁，取代了任务级或样本级的教师路由。H-OPD 采用视觉到语言的描述迁移技术，使纯文本教师能够获取关键的视觉语义，并使用……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 H-OPD 框架，以置信度感知的 token 级异构多教师仲裁取代传统静态的任务/样本级教师路由，并通过视觉到语言的描述迁移让纯文本教师获取关键视觉语义，从而显著提升多模态推理在线蒸馏的效果。
en_tdlr: H-OPD is a confidence-aware heterogeneous multi-teacher on-policy distillation framework that replaces static task/sample-level teacher routing with token-level teacher arbitration along the student trajectory, leveraging vision-to-language description transfer to enable text-only teachers to access key visual semantics for improved multimodal reasoning.
